newsitem.title: USA: Geerlings & Wade Inc names CFO.
newsitem.headline: Geerlings & Wade Inc names CFO.

text.p: Geerlings & Wade Inc said Wednesday it has named David Pearce vice president and chief financial officer.
Most recently, Pearce was chief financial officer of State Line Tack Inc, a direct-mail retailer and catalogue of equestrian products that was acquired in January by PETsMart Inc.

Pearce succeeds Peter McAree who is leaving the company to pursue "other professional opportunities," the company said in a statement. McAree will be staying for an unspecified amount of time as a transition.
Geerlings & Wade is a direct marketer of wines in the United States.
